title: Financial Announcement Parser — 财报公告解析器
description: Implement a structured extraction pipeline for Chinese financial announcements (earnings reports, prospectuses, board resolutions). The parser MUST use TextPreprocessor for abbreviation expansion, extract 5+ financial metrics (revenue, net_profit, eps, roe, gross_margin), handle number format normalization (亿/万→float), preserve approximation markers, and output AnnouncementResult frozen dataclass. Depends on F-041 NER Engine for entity recognition and F-044 Lexicon for text preprocessing.

criteria: 5+ financial metrics extracted: [revenue, net_profit, eps, roe, gross_margin]
AnnouncementResult frozen dataclass with 8 fields: [metrics, period_info, growth_highlights, risk_factors, entities, approximation_markers, confidence, processing_time_ms]
14+ unit tests pass: verify by py -m pytest tests/unit/test_announcement_parser.py -p no:asyncio -q (exit code 0)
All frozen dataclasses use frozen=True, slots=True pattern
convergence.definition_of_done: Announcement parser extracts 5+ metrics from Chinese earnings text with abbreviation expansion and approximation markers

20+ regex patterns for financial metric extraction (revenue, profit, EPS, ROE, etc.)

implementation.title: Create financial extraction patterns
implementation.description: Create synapse/nlp/patterns/financial_patterns.py with 20+ regex patterns for extracting financial metrics from Chinese text. Patterns handle: revenue (营业收入/营收/总收入), net profit (净利润/归母净利润), EPS (每股收益), ROE (净资产收益率/ROE), gross margin (毛利率), period detection (Q1/Q2/Q3/Q4/年报), approximation markers (约/超/近).
modification_points: Create 1 new file with 20+ regex patterns
Pattern groups: revenue, profit, eps, roe, margin, period, approximation
logic_flow: Each pattern captures: value, unit (亿/万), approximation marker
Define PERIOD_PATTERNS for Q1-Q4 and annual report detection
Define APPROXIMATION_MARKERS list (约/超/近/左右/超过)

implementation.title: Implement AnnouncementParser
implementation.description: Create synapse/nlp/announcement_parser.py with AnnouncementParser class. Methods: parse(text: TextDocument) -> AnnouncementResult. Pipeline: (1) TextPreprocessor.expand_abbreviations, (2) regex metric extraction, (3) period detection, (4) NER entity extraction for company/auditor, (5) approximation marker preservation, (6) confidence scoring.
logic_flow: Compute confidence score based on metrics found
